C-OFFER-EDITOR-DRAFT-PUBLISH-20261118.IntentSummary: Replace the write-through offer editor with a PostgreSQL wrapper of streams holding draft edits (add, remove, bring back, pin), pinned-aware equal share split, and explicit Push / Cancel / Fetch Streams against Keitaro; update API contract and FSD frontend accordingly.

T-001.Title: DB wrapper: Stream and StreamOffer ORM models and Alembic migration 0002.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: streams (Keitaro stream id PK, campaign_id, meta, is_dirty, published_snapshot JSONB) and stream_offers (unique stream_id+offer_id, status, share, pinned, in_keitaro) exist after alembic upgrade head; downgrade drops them. Covered by make gate-backend (mypy) and a live alembic upgrade; schema parity with models is a review obligation.

T-002.Title: Keitaro client: get_offer lookup tolerant to permission errors.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: get_offer returns the offer, None on permission denied, raises NotFoundError on 404. Covered by make gate-backend; live behaviour observed against the test tracker.

T-003.Title: Editor service: fetch sync, draft add/remove/restore/pin/unpin, pinned-aware rebalance, push, cancel, audit log.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Share rule and lifecycle from the spec hold; only fetch and push call Keitaro. Covered by make gate-backend; share arithmetic correctness is a review obligation recorded in V-M-OFFER-EDITOR and checked by the live scenario.

T-004.Title: API: editor routes and DTOs (fetch, add, remove, restore, pin, unpin, push, cancel; drop manual PUT shares), regenerate contract and TS types.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: contracts/openapi.json and schema.d.ts reflect the new endpoints and fields; make gate-openapi exits 0.

T-005.Title: Frontend FSD: features fetch-streams, add-offer, remove-offer (no dialog), restore-offer, pin-offer, publish-stream; drop edit-shares; stream card yellow draft state with Push/Cancel; editor page Fetch Streams.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: make gate-frontend exits 0 (oxlint, steiger FSD, tsc, vite build); UI behaviour matches spec acceptance criteria in a browser check.

T-006.Title: Durable reconciliation: graph summaries, verification scenarios, requirements decision, UX guideline, README.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .grace graph/verification/context describe the draft/publish editor; grace lint reports 0 errors.
